project.name: GGClips
project.summary: A proposed mobile-first clip site for adult GTA 6 fans, starting with a small group of authorized streamer partners. AI helps prepare clips, but a human checks rights and quality before anything is published.

nodes.label: Website
nodes.summary: The public clip experience and the private tools editors use to review content.

nodes.label: Pages and journeys
nodes.summary: The pages for discovering clips, viewing streamers, reporting content, and managing accounts.

nodes.label: Editor workspace
nodes.summary: Private review pages where editors approve clip drafts and act on reports.

nodes.label: Site requests
nodes.summary: The site's own routes for public catalogue data and protected editor actions.

nodes.label: Shared page parts
nodes.summary: Reusable video, warning, account, report, and review controls.

nodes.label: Site connections

nodes.label: Clip preparation
nodes.summary: A role-based agent pipeline checks permissions, proposes moments, prepares clips and captions, and stops for human approval.

nodes.label: Agent orchestrator
nodes.summary: Runs each specialist role in order, tracks progress, and never publishes without an editor's approval.

nodes.label: Permission gate
nodes.summary: Checks partner permission and processing scope before a source is sent to any model.

nodes.label: Moment finder agent
nodes.summary: Finds candidate moments in an approved source and returns timestamps with reasons for an editor.

nodes.label: Caption agent
nodes.summary: Creates timed draft captions and marks words that need a person to check them.

nodes.label: Clip editing tools
nodes.summary: Cuts, crops, and assembles the suggested segment into a vertical draft.

nodes.label: Safety review agent
nodes.summary: Flags possible adult content, spoilers, private information, and uncertain context for human review.

nodes.label: Media quality checks
nodes.summary: Checks that draft files, captions, timing, and required review details are present and usable.

nodes.label: Promotion draft agent
nodes.summary: Writes optional social post drafts for approved clips; it does not publish to social accounts.

nodes.label: Supabase database and accounts
nodes.summary: Proposed managed storage for catalogue records, permissions, reports, and editor accounts.

nodes.label: Supabase source storage
nodes.summary: Proposed private storage for partner-provided source files and permission records.

nodes.label: Managed video delivery

nodes.label: Video analysis model
nodes.summary: Proposed paid model service that suggests moments and timestamps from authorized videos.

nodes.label: Video editing tools

flows.title: Find and watch a clip
flows.description: A visitor sees the age notice, finds an approved clip, and watches it with captions.

steps.note: The visitor opens the clip feed and acknowledges the adult-content notice.
The site asks for clips that are approved and publicly available.
Only published catalogue entries are returned.
The video service delivers the clip at a suitable size for the device.
The player shows controls, captions, streamer credit, and a report link.

flows.title: Run the clip agents
flows.description: A permission gate passes an approved source to specialist agents; editing and quality tools prepare a draft; an editor decides what gets published.

steps.note: An editor registers a partner source and its permission evidence.
The protected route records the source and starts a preparation job.
The source file remains in private storage.
The permission gate confirms that this source may be processed before it reaches an AI model.
The orchestrator assigns bounded tasks to specialist agents and tracks their results.
The moment finder proposes interesting segments with timestamps and reasons.
The model helps interpret approved video and audio; it cannot approve rights or publish.
The caption agent creates timed draft subtitles and flags uncertain words.
The safety reviewer flags possible violence, language, spoilers, and private information.
The editing tools cut and crop the chosen segment and add the draft captions.
The proposed media tool performs deterministic cutting and vertical framing.
Automated checks catch broken files, missing captions, duplicates, and incomplete review details.
A review rendition is prepared for the editor; it is not public yet.
An editor checks the rights, context, captions, framing, and warnings before deciding whether to publish.
After approval, the promotion agent can prepare social drafts for a person to review and publish manually.

flows.title: Report and remove a clip
flows.description: A visitor reports a concern and an editor can suspend the clip while reviewing it.

steps.note: The visitor opens the report form from a clip.
The site records the report and applies spam protections.
The report and moderation history are stored for review.
An editor reviews the case and records the decision.
The takedown action removes the clip from public listing and playback.
